versions.changelog:
Sunny Health Monitor v1.0.0 – initial release!

- Provides lightweight system health monitoring for macOS (CPU, memory, disk, network, processes)
- Monitors cron job health, tracks success/failure/timeout rates, and generates detailed reports
- Calculates an overall health score with actionable optimization suggestions
- Delivers automated health reports and notifications directly to Discord
- Supports both scheduled (cron) and manual analysis modes
